title: Rewrite migration to read from localStorage data
description: Update the migrateAnonymousData mutation to accept full progress data as an argument (from localStorage) instead of reading from Convex by visitorId. Add thorough validation and sanitization before inserting to database.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Mutation accepts AnonymousProgress object as argument
Validates all data types before insertion
Enforces string length limits (e.g., persian/songId max 500 chars)
Enforces array size limits (e.g., max 10,000 words)
Enforces numeric bounds (positive integers, reasonable maximums)
Validates songId format matches Convex ID pattern
Rejects malformed data gracefully (partial success OK)
Returns count of successfully migrated records
verify.tsx updated to read localStorage and pass to mutation

technicalNotes: Update src/routes/auth/verify.tsx to read full localStorage and pass as argument
Use Zod or manual validation for type safety
Log validation failures for debugging but don't expose to client
testingNotes: Unit test: rejects malicious string content
Unit test: successfully migrates valid data
Integration test: full signup flow migrates localStorage to Convex
